findings.title: Layers in the reporting chain (Belmar)
findings.detail: Counted from who reports to whom, for the people whose Country is Belmar. The chain starts at the group chief executive in Arden.
findings.source_note: Computed from the uploaded org file (26 people in Belmar)

findings.title: Why Head of Pricing / Revenue Management exists in Belmar
findings.detail: Created in 2023 when Belmar won its two largest renewal contracts; Arden has no such role and leaves pricing to finance.
findings.source_note: Stated by the country manager; headcount from the uploaded org file.

findings.title: Why Head, Analytics & AI is absent in Belmar
findings.detail: Belmar buys analytics as a service rather than staffing a team: a deliberate decision taken in 2025 on cost grounds.
findings.source_note: Reason stated by the country manager; headcount from the uploaded org file.

findings.title: Why Hub Duty Controller (disruption) is absent in Belmar
findings.detail: Covered by rotating shift supervisors since the merger; nobody holds disruption judgement as their job. Arden has one, on a thin bench.
findings.source_note: Stated in three interviews; headcount from the uploaded org file.
